purpose: Teach: 至急/台帳/雇い/シンクタンク/区民/区内/チームワーク/不明確

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、至急、絶対、対応、絶対、すべきこと、絶対、自分で、絶対、判断したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: In my father's time, I made every decision myself — every hire, every choice. I did it with complete commitment, and I ask that you carry that forward.
lines.style: Quiet, measured opening. Weight on each commitment made. Long-view pause mid-sentence. Voice settles lower at 'I ask' — not demanding, passing a trust.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、帳簿、絶対、台帳、絶対、紙で、絶対、管理してきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Ever since your father's time, we've kept the books, the records, everything on paper and in person. That continuity — I'm grateful for it.
lines.style: Respectful, steady cadence. Slight emphasis on 'ever since' — acknowledging the thread. Warm undertone on 'grateful,' not effusive but genuine.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、社員の、絶対、雇い入れ、絶対、自分の目で、絶対、見て決めたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father looked every person in the eye before hiring them. He trusted his own judgment on that. That's how we built this place.
lines.style: Nostalgic, leaning back slightly in memory. Pause after 'eye' — vivid and specific. Voice carries pride without self-consciousness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、シンクタンク、絶対、お父さんが、絶対、関わってきた、絶対、伝統、絶対、続いております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. That tradition of careful judgment — the think tank Dad helped shape — it's still at the heart of what we do. I'm grateful to uphold it.
lines.style: Steady, almost reverent tone. Gentle emphasis on 'tradition.' Speaks to continuity as something living, not past. Closes with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、区民、絶対、向けの、絶対、企画、絶対、当時から、絶対、大切にしたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: My father cared about the people in our ward from the very beginning. He built projects with them in mind. That mattered to him.
lines.style: Soft, almost tender. Voice lightens on 'ward' — intimate scale. Lingers on 'that mattered' — a gentle insistence that this wasn't just business.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。区内、本気で、絶対、お父さんの代から、絶対、お客様、絶対、根付いておられます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The customers we've served in this ward since your father's time — they've put down roots with us. That's a responsibility I hold close.
lines.style: Warm, steady. Slight lift on 'roots' — metaphor lands gently. Voice deepens on 'responsibility,' showing he understands the weight being passed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員の、絶対、チームワーク、絶対、大切にしてきたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Since my father's time, we've valued teamwork among our staff. That hasn't changed. We do this together.
lines.style: Even, grounded tone. Short, declarative sentences — each one firm. No flourish. Closes on 'together' with quiet emphasis.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さん、本気で、絶対、不明確、絶対、な指示、絶対、絶対しなかったと、絶対、ばあさんから、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Your father — your mother told me this — he never gave unclear orders. That clarity, that care in how he spoke to people. I've tried to carry that.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost intimate. Slight pause before 'your mother told me' — honoring the source. Voice softens, becomes more personal. Closes with understated commitment.
